name: Bandage
rules: Heal 3 health, up to your maximum.
quip: A temporary fix for a permanent concern.

name: Medkit
rules: Spend 2 actions to heal 6 health, up to your maximum.

name: Painkillers
rules: Heal 2 health, up to your maximum. Draw 1 card.
quip: Take the edge off. Keep the attitude.

name: Field Dressing
rules: Heal 4 health, up to your maximum.
quip: Apply pressure to yourself and the enemy.
